# Exact formulas

Every canonical metric of methodology 0.1.0, exactly as implemented. Symbols are defined in [notation](notation.md); thresholds and constants are listed in [policies](policies.md). Each formula is also shown on the metric's own page together with its applicability and confidence criteria.

## Return summary

### Cumulative return — [`cumulative_return`](../interpretation/cumulative_return.md)

```math
\mathrm{CR} = W_n - 1 = \prod_{t=1}^{n} (1 + r_t) - 1
```

### Annualized return (CAGR) — [`cagr`](../interpretation/cagr.md)

```math
\mathrm{CAGR} = \begin{cases} W_n^{P/n} - 1 & W_n > 0 \\ -1 & W_n \le 0 \end{cases}
```

### Mean return per period — [`arithmetic_mean`](../interpretation/arithmetic_mean.md)

```math
\bar r = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{t=1}^{n} r_t
```

### Geometric mean return per period — [`geometric_mean_return`](../interpretation/geometric_mean_return.md)

```math
\bar r_g = \begin{cases} W_n^{1/n} - 1 & W_n > 0 \\ -1 & W_n \le 0 \end{cases}
```

### Annualized mean return (arithmetic) — [`annualized_arithmetic_mean`](../interpretation/annualized_arithmetic_mean.md)

```math
\bar r_{\text{ann}} = P \, \bar r
```

### Median return per period — [`median_return`](../interpretation/median_return.md)

```math
\operatorname{med}(r) = \begin{cases} r_{((n+1)/2)} & n \text{ odd} \\ \tfrac{1}{2}\left(r_{(n/2)} + r_{(n/2+1)}\right) & n \text{ even} \end{cases}
```

### Best period — [`best_period`](../interpretation/best_period.md)

```math
\max_{1 \le t \le n} r_t = r_{(n)}
```

### Worst period — [`worst_period`](../interpretation/worst_period.md)

```math
\min_{1 \le t \le n} r_t = r_{(1)}
```

### Gain-to-pain ratio — [`gain_to_pain_ratio`](../interpretation/gain_to_pain_ratio.md)

```math
\mathrm{GPR} = \frac{\sum_{t=1}^{n} r_t}{\left| \sum_{t:\, r_t < 0} r_t \right|}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: No period has a negative return (zero denominator).

### Payoff ratio (average win / average loss) — [`payoff_ratio`](../interpretation/payoff_ratio.md)

```math
\mathrm{Payoff} = \frac{\frac{1}{|G|} \sum_{t \in G} r_t}{\left| \frac{1}{|L|} \sum_{t \in L} r_t \right|}, \quad G = \{t : r_t > 0\}, \ L = \{t : r_t < 0\}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: No positive period or no negative period exists.

### Profit factor (gross gains / gross losses) — [`profit_factor`](../interpretation/profit_factor.md)

```math
\mathrm{PF} = \frac{\sum_{t \in G} r_t}{\left| \sum_{t \in L} r_t \right|} = 1 + \mathrm{GPR}, \quad G = \{t : r_t > 0\}, \ L = \{t : r_t < 0\}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: No negative period exists (the denominator is zero).

## Risk summary

### Volatility per period — [`volatility`](../interpretation/volatility.md)

```math
s = \sqrt{\frac{1}{n-1} \sum_{t=1}^{n} \left(r_t - \bar r\right)^2}
```

### Annualized volatility — [`annualized_volatility`](../interpretation/annualized_volatility.md)

```math
\sigma_{\text{ann}} = s \sqrt{P}
```

### Mean absolute deviation — [`mean_absolute_deviation`](../interpretation/mean_absolute_deviation.md)

```math
\mathrm{MAD} = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{t=1}^{n} \left| r_t - \bar r \right|
```

### Interquartile range — [`interquartile_range`](../interpretation/interquartile_range.md)

```math
\mathrm{IQR} = Q_{0.75}(r) - Q_{0.25}(r)
```

### Downside deviation (annualized) — [`downside_deviation`](../interpretation/downside_deviation.md)

```math
\mathrm{DD}_{\text{ann}} = \sqrt{P}\,\mathrm{DD}, \quad \mathrm{DD} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{n} \sum_{t=1}^{n} \min(r_t - \tau, 0)^2}, \quad \tau = 0
```

### Semi-deviation (annualized) — [`semi_deviation`](../interpretation/semi_deviation.md)

```math
\mathrm{SemiDev}_{\text{ann}} = \sqrt{P} \, \sqrt{\frac{1}{n} \sum_{t=1}^{n} \min(r_t - \bar r, 0)^2}
```

### Downside potential (LPM 1) — [`downside_potential`](../interpretation/downside_potential.md)

```math
\mathrm{LPM}_1 = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{t=1}^{n} \max(\tau - r_t, 0), \quad \tau = 0
```

## Drawdowns

### Maximum drawdown — [`max_drawdown`](../interpretation/max_drawdown.md)

```math
\mathrm{MDD} = \min_{0 \le t \le n} D_t, \quad D_t = \frac{W_t}{M_t} - 1, \quad M_t = \max_{0 \le u \le t} W_u, \quad W_0 = 1
```

### Average drawdown (per episode) — [`average_drawdown`](../interpretation/average_drawdown.md)

```math
\overline{\mathrm{DD}} = \begin{cases} \frac{1}{K} \sum_{k=1}^{K} \delta_k & K > 0 \\ 0 & K = 0 \end{cases}, \quad \delta_k = \min_{t \in E_k} D_t
```

### Current drawdown — [`current_drawdown`](../interpretation/current_drawdown.md)

```math
D_n = \frac{W_n}{M_n} - 1
```

### Longest drawdown duration — [`longest_drawdown_duration`](../interpretation/longest_drawdown_duration.md)

```math
L_{\max} = \max_{1 \le k \le K} \ell_k, \quad \ell_k = \begin{cases} \rho_k - \pi_k & \text{episode } k \text{ recovered} \\ n - \pi_k & \text{episode } k \text{ ongoing} \end{cases}, \quad L_{\max} = 0 \text{ if } K = 0
```

### Number of drawdown episodes — [`drawdown_count`](../interpretation/drawdown_count.md)

```math
K = \#\{\text{maximal runs } t_1..t_2 \subseteq 1..n \text{ with } D_t < 0 \ \forall t \in t_1..t_2\}
```

### Time under water — [`time_underwater_pct`](../interpretation/time_underwater_pct.md)

```math
\mathrm{TUW} = \frac{1}{n} \#\{t \in 1..n : D_t < 0\}
```

### Ulcer Index — [`ulcer_index`](../interpretation/ulcer_index.md)

```math
\mathrm{UI} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{n} \sum_{t=1}^{n} D_t^2}
```

### Pain Index — [`pain_index`](../interpretation/pain_index.md)

```math
\mathrm{PI} = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{t=1}^{n} \left| D_t \right|
```

### Median drawdown (per episode) — [`median_drawdown`](../interpretation/median_drawdown.md)

```math
\widetilde{\mathrm{DD}} = \operatorname{med}\left(\delta_1, \dots, \delta_K\right), \quad 0 \text{ if } K = 0
```

### Average drawdown duration — [`average_drawdown_duration`](../interpretation/average_drawdown_duration.md)

```math
\bar\ell = \frac{1}{K} \sum_{k=1}^{K} \ell_k, \quad \ell_k = \begin{cases} \rho_k - \pi_k & \text{recovered} \\ n - \pi_k & \text{ongoing} \end{cases}, \quad 0 \text{ if } K = 0
```

### Longest decline (peak to trough) — [`max_peak_to_trough_duration`](../interpretation/max_peak_to_trough_duration.md)

```math
\max_{1 \le k \le K} \left( \tau_k - \pi_k \right), \quad \tau_k = \arg\min_{t \in E_k} D_t \ (\text{first occurrence}), \quad 0 \text{ if } K = 0
```

### Average recovery time (trough to recovery) — [`average_recovery_duration`](../interpretation/average_recovery_duration.md)

```math
\bar R = \frac{1}{|K_r|} \sum_{k \in K_r} (\rho_k - \tau_k), \quad K_r = \{k : \text{episode } k \text{ recovered}\}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: No drawdown episode has recovered (none occurred, or all are open).

### Drawdown-at-Risk (95%) — [`drawdown_at_risk_95`](../interpretation/drawdown_at_risk_95.md)

```math
\mathrm{DaR}_{95} = Q_{0.05}\left(D_1, \dots, D_n\right)
```

### Conditional Drawdown-at-Risk (95%) — [`cdar_95`](../interpretation/cdar_95.md)

```math
\mathrm{CDaR}_{95} = \frac{1}{|T|} \sum_{t \in T} D_t, \quad T = \{t \in 1..n : D_t \le Q_{0.05}(D)\}
```

### Entropic Drawdown-at-Risk (95%) — [`edar_95`](../interpretation/edar_95.md)

```math
\mathrm{EDaR}_{95} = -\mathrm{EVaR}_{0.05}(-D), \quad \mathrm{EVaR}_{a}(X) = \inf_{z > 0} \, z \ln\!\left( \frac{1}{a\,n} \sum_{t=1}^{n} e^{X_t / z} \right)
```

## Risk-adjusted performance

### Sharpe ratio — [`sharpe_ratio`](../interpretation/sharpe_ratio.md)

```math
\mathrm{SR} = \frac{\bar r - r_f}{s} \sqrt{P}, \quad r_f = 0
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Sample standard deviation is exactly zero (constant returns).

### Sortino ratio — [`sortino_ratio`](../interpretation/sortino_ratio.md)

```math
\mathrm{Sortino} = \frac{P\,(\bar r - \tau)}{\mathrm{DD}\,\sqrt{P}} = \frac{\bar r - \tau}{\mathrm{DD}} \sqrt{P}, \quad \tau = 0
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: No return is below the 0% target (downside deviation is zero).

### Calmar ratio — [`calmar_ratio`](../interpretation/calmar_ratio.md)

```math
\mathrm{Calmar} = \frac{\mathrm{CAGR}}{\left| \mathrm{MDD} \right|}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: No drawdown occurred (maximum drawdown is zero).

### Martin ratio (Ulcer Performance Index) — [`martin_ratio`](../interpretation/martin_ratio.md)

```math
\mathrm{Martin} = \frac{\mathrm{CAGR} - r_f}{\mathrm{UI}}, \quad r_f = 0
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: No drawdown occurred (Ulcer Index is zero).

### Omega ratio — [`omega_ratio`](../interpretation/omega_ratio.md)

```math
\Omega(L) = \frac{\sum_{t=1}^{n} \max(r_t - L, 0)}{\sum_{t=1}^{n} \max(L - r_t, 0)}, \quad L = 0
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: No return is below the 0% threshold (zero denominator).

### Kappa 3 ratio — [`kappa_3_ratio`](../interpretation/kappa_3_ratio.md)

```math
K_3 = \frac{\bar r - \tau}{\left( \frac{1}{n} \sum_{t=1}^{n} \max(\tau - r_t, 0)^3 \right)^{1/3}}, \quad \tau = 0
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: No return is below the 0% target (zero lower partial moment).

### Upside potential ratio — [`upside_potential_ratio`](../interpretation/upside_potential_ratio.md)

```math
\mathrm{UPR} = \frac{\frac{1}{n} \sum_{t=1}^{n} \max(r_t - \tau, 0)}{\mathrm{DD}}, \quad \tau = 0
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: No return is below the 0% target (downside deviation is zero).

### Burke ratio — [`burke_ratio`](../interpretation/burke_ratio.md)

```math
\mathrm{Burke} = \frac{\mathrm{CAGR} - r_f}{\sqrt{\sum_{k=1}^{K} \delta_k^2}}, \quad r_f = 0
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: No drawdown occurred (K = 0).

### Sterling ratio — [`sterling_ratio`](../interpretation/sterling_ratio.md)

```math
\mathrm{Sterling} = \frac{\mathrm{CAGR}}{\left| \mathrm{MDD} \right| + e}, \quad e = 0.10
```

### Pain ratio — [`pain_ratio`](../interpretation/pain_ratio.md)

```math
\mathrm{PR} = \frac{\mathrm{CAGR} - r_f}{\mathrm{PI}}, \quad r_f = 0
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: No drawdown occurred (Pain Index is zero).

### Recovery factor — [`recovery_factor`](../interpretation/recovery_factor.md)

```math
\mathrm{RF} = \frac{W_n - 1}{\left| \mathrm{MDD} \right|}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: No drawdown occurred (maximum drawdown is zero).

### Sharpe ratio (serial-correlation adjusted, Lo 2002) — [`sharpe_ratio_autocorrelation_adjusted`](../interpretation/sharpe_ratio_autocorrelation_adjusted.md)

```math
\mathrm{SR}_{\mathrm{Lo}} = \frac{\bar r - r_f}{s} \, \eta(q), \quad \eta(q) = \frac{q}{\sqrt{q + 2 \sum_{k=1}^{q-1} (q-k) \hat\rho_k}} = \sqrt{\frac{q}{\mathrm{VR}(q)}}, \quad q = \operatorname{round}(P), \quad r_f = 0
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: The frequency is not regular or there is one observation per year (q = 1). Fewer than two years of observations (n < 2q). Sample standard deviation is exactly zero (constant returns). q + 2 sum (q - k) rho_k <= 0 (estimated autocorrelations imply a non-positive one-year variance).

## Tail behavior

### Value at Risk (historical, 95%) — [`var_historical_95`](../interpretation/var_historical_95.md)

```math
\mathrm{VaR}_{95} = Q_{0.05}(r), \quad Q_p(r) = r_{(j)} + (h - j)\left(r_{(j+1)} - r_{(j)}\right), \ h = (n-1)p + 1, \ j = \lfloor h \rfloor
```

### Expected Shortfall / CVaR (historical, 95%) — [`expected_shortfall_historical_95`](../interpretation/expected_shortfall_historical_95.md)

```math
\mathrm{ES}_{95} = \frac{1}{|T|} \sum_{t \in T} r_t, \quad T = \{t : r_t \le Q_{0.05}(r)\}
```

### Tail ratio (95th / 5th percentile) — [`tail_ratio`](../interpretation/tail_ratio.md)

```math
\mathrm{TR} = \frac{\left| Q_{0.95}(r) \right|}{\left| Q_{0.05}(r) \right|}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: The 5th percentile return is exactly zero.

### Value at Risk (Gaussian, 95%) — [`gaussian_var_95`](../interpretation/gaussian_var_95.md)

```math
\mathrm{VaR}^{N}_{95} = \bar r + z_{0.05} \sqrt{m_2}, \quad z_{0.05} = \Phi^{-1}(0.05) \approx -1.645
```

### Modified VaR (Cornish-Fisher, 95%) — [`modified_var_95`](../interpretation/modified_var_95.md)

```math
\mathrm{mVaR}_{95} = \bar r + h \sqrt{m_2}, \quad h = z + \frac{(z^2 - 1) S}{6} + \frac{(z^3 - 3z) K}{24} - \frac{(2z^3 - 5z) S^2}{36}, \quad z = \Phi^{-1}(0.05), \ S = \frac{m_3}{m_2^{3/2}}, \ K = \frac{m_4}{m_2^2} - 3
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Return variance is zero or underflows in floating point (e.g. identical returns).

### Modified Expected Shortfall (Cornish-Fisher, 95%) — [`modified_es_95`](../interpretation/modified_es_95.md)

```math
\mathrm{mES}_{95} = \bar r - \frac{\sqrt{m_2}}{a}\,\varphi(h)\left[1 + \frac{h^3 S}{6} + \frac{(h^6 - 9h^4 + 9h^2 + 3) S^2}{72} + \frac{(h^4 - 2h^2 - 1) K}{24}\right], \quad a = 0.05, \ h = \text{CF quantile of modified\_var\_95}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Return variance is zero or underflows in floating point (e.g. identical returns).

### Entropic Value at Risk (95%) — [`evar_95`](../interpretation/evar_95.md)

```math
\mathrm{EVaR}_{95} = -\mathrm{EVaR}_{0.05}(-r), \quad \mathrm{EVaR}_{a}(X) = \inf_{z > 0} \, z \ln\!\left( \frac{1}{a\,n} \sum_{t=1}^{n} e^{X_t / z} \right)
```

## Distribution

### Skewness — [`skewness`](../interpretation/skewness.md)

```math
G_1 = \frac{\sqrt{n(n-1)}}{n-2} \, \frac{m_3}{m_2^{3/2}}, \quad m_k = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{t=1}^{n} (r_t - \bar r)^k
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Return variance is zero or underflows in floating point (e.g. identical returns).

### Excess kurtosis — [`excess_kurtosis`](../interpretation/excess_kurtosis.md)

```math
G_2 = \frac{n-1}{(n-2)(n-3)} \left[ (n+1) \frac{m_4}{m_2^2} - 3(n-1) \right]
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Return variance is zero or underflows in floating point (e.g. identical returns).

### Jarque-Bera normality p-value — [`jarque_bera_pvalue`](../interpretation/jarque_bera_pvalue.md)

```math
JB = \frac{n}{6}\left( g_1^2 + \frac{g_2^2}{4} \right), \quad g_1 = \frac{m_3}{m_2^{3/2}}, \ g_2 = \frac{m_4}{m_2^2} - 3, \quad p = 1 - F_{\chi^2_2}(JB)
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Return variance is zero or underflows in floating point (e.g. identical returns).

## Consistency

### Positive periods — [`positive_period_pct`](../interpretation/positive_period_pct.md)

```math
\mathrm{Pos} = \frac{1}{n} \#\{t : r_t > 0\}
```

### Negative periods — [`negative_period_pct`](../interpretation/negative_period_pct.md)

```math
\mathrm{Neg} = \frac{1}{n} \#\{t : r_t < 0\}
```

### Longest run of positive periods — [`longest_winning_streak`](../interpretation/longest_winning_streak.md)

```math
\max \{ j - i + 1 : 1 \le i \le j \le n,\ r_u > 0 \ \forall u \in i..j \} \ (0 \text{ if no } r_t > 0)
```

### Longest run of negative periods — [`longest_losing_streak`](../interpretation/longest_losing_streak.md)

```math
\max \{ j - i + 1 : 1 \le i \le j \le n,\ r_u < 0 \ \forall u \in i..j \} \ (0 \text{ if no } r_t < 0)
```

### Best calendar year — [`best_calendar_year`](../interpretation/best_calendar_year.md)

```math
\max_{y \in Y} R_y, \quad R_y = \prod_{t \in y} (1 + r_t) - 1 \ \text{ for each complete calendar year } y \in Y
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: No complete calendar year is covered by the history. The returns are undated or the frequency is irregular.

### Worst calendar year — [`worst_calendar_year`](../interpretation/worst_calendar_year.md)

```math
\min_{y \in Y} R_y, \quad R_y = \prod_{t \in y} (1 + r_t) - 1 \ \text{ for each complete calendar year } y \in Y
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: No complete calendar year is covered by the history. The returns are undated or the frequency is irregular.

### Positive calendar years — [`positive_calendar_years_pct`](../interpretation/positive_calendar_years_pct.md)

```math
\frac{\#\{y \in Y : R_y > 0\}}{|Y|}, \quad R_y = \prod_{t \in y} (1 + r_t) - 1 \ \text{ for each complete calendar year } y \in Y
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: No complete calendar year is covered by the history. The returns are undated or the frequency is irregular.

### Best rolling one-year return — [`best_rolling_year`](../interpretation/best_rolling_year.md)

```math
\max_{w \le t \le n} R^{(w)}_t, \quad R^{(w)}_t = \prod_{i=t-w+1}^{t} (1 + r_i) - 1, \quad t = w, \dots, n, \quad w = \operatorname{round}(P)
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Fewer observations than one year (n < w).

### Worst rolling one-year return — [`worst_rolling_year`](../interpretation/worst_rolling_year.md)

```math
\min_{w \le t \le n} R^{(w)}_t, \quad R^{(w)}_t = \prod_{i=t-w+1}^{t} (1 + r_i) - 1, \quad t = w, \dots, n, \quad w = \operatorname{round}(P)
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Fewer observations than one year (n < w).

### Positive rolling one-year windows — [`positive_rolling_year_pct`](../interpretation/positive_rolling_year_pct.md)

```math
\frac{\#\{t : R^{(w)}_t > 0\}}{n - w + 1}, \quad R^{(w)}_t = \prod_{i=t-w+1}^{t} (1 + r_i) - 1, \quad t = w, \dots, n, \quad w = \operatorname{round}(P)
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Fewer observations than one year (n < w).

## Serial dependence & smoothing

### Autocorrelation (lag 1) — [`autocorrelation_lag1`](../interpretation/autocorrelation_lag1.md)

```math
\hat\rho_1 = \frac{\sum_{t=2}^{n} (r_t - \bar r)(r_{t-1} - \bar r)}{\sum_{t=1}^{n} (r_t - \bar r)^2}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: n <= 2 observations. All returns are identical (zero variance).

### Autocorrelation (lag 2) — [`autocorrelation_lag2`](../interpretation/autocorrelation_lag2.md)

```math
\hat\rho_2 = \frac{\sum_{t=3}^{n} (r_t - \bar r)(r_{t-2} - \bar r)}{\sum_{t=1}^{n} (r_t - \bar r)^2}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: n <= 3 observations. All returns are identical (zero variance).

### Autocorrelation (lag 3) — [`autocorrelation_lag3`](../interpretation/autocorrelation_lag3.md)

```math
\hat\rho_3 = \frac{\sum_{t=4}^{n} (r_t - \bar r)(r_{t-3} - \bar r)}{\sum_{t=1}^{n} (r_t - \bar r)^2}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: n <= 4 observations. All returns are identical (zero variance).

### Ljung-Box p-value (3 lags) — [`ljung_box_pvalue`](../interpretation/ljung_box_pvalue.md)

```math
Q = n(n+2) \sum_{k=1}^{3} \frac{\hat\rho_k^2}{n-k}, \quad p = 1 - F_{\chi^2_3}(Q)
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: All returns are identical (zero variance).

### Zero-return periods — [`zero_return_pct`](../interpretation/zero_return_pct.md)

```math
Z = \frac{1}{n} \#\{t : r_t = 0\}
```

### Variance ratio (one-year horizon) — [`variance_ratio_1y`](../interpretation/variance_ratio_1y.md)

```math
\mathrm{VR}(q) = 1 + 2 \sum_{k=1}^{q-1} \Big(1 - \frac{k}{q}\Big) \hat\rho_k, \quad q = \operatorname{round}(P), \quad z = \frac{\mathrm{VR}(q) - 1}{\sqrt{2 (2q-1)(q-1) / (3 q n)}}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: The frequency is not regular (P undefined) or there is one observation per year (q = 1). Fewer than two years of observations (n < 2q). All returns are identical (zero variance).

## Benchmark-relative analysis

### Beta — [`beta`](../interpretation/beta.md)

```math
\hat\beta = \frac{\sum_{t=1}^{m} (r_t - \bar r)(b_t - \bar b)}{\sum_{t=1}^{m} (b_t - \bar b)^2} \quad \text{(OLS slope of } r_t = \alpha + \beta b_t + \varepsilon_t)
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Benchmark returns are constant over the aligned periods.

### Alpha (annualized, CAPM regression) — [`alpha`](../interpretation/alpha.md)

```math
\alpha_{\text{ann}} = P \, \hat\alpha, \quad \hat\alpha = \bar r - \hat\beta \, \bar b
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Benchmark returns are constant over the aligned periods.

### R-squared — [`r_squared`](../interpretation/r_squared.md)

```math
R^2 = 1 - \frac{\sum_{t=1}^{m} \hat\varepsilon_t^2}{\sum_{t=1}^{m} (r_t - \bar r)^2}, \quad \hat\varepsilon_t = r_t - \hat\alpha - \hat\beta b_t
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Benchmark returns are constant over the aligned periods. Fund returns are constant over the aligned periods (no variance to explain).

### Correlation with benchmark — [`correlation`](../interpretation/correlation.md)

```math
\rho_{rb} = \frac{\sum_{t=1}^{m} (r_t - \bar r)(b_t - \bar b)}{\sqrt{\sum_{t=1}^{m} (r_t - \bar r)^2 \, \sum_{t=1}^{m} (b_t - \bar b)^2}}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Fund or benchmark returns are constant over the aligned periods.

### Tracking error (annualized) — [`tracking_error`](../interpretation/tracking_error.md)

```math
\mathrm{TE} = s_a \sqrt{P}, \quad s_a = \sqrt{\frac{1}{m-1} \sum_{t=1}^{m} (a_t - \bar a)^2}, \quad a_t = r_t - b_t
```

### Active return (annualized, arithmetic) — [`active_return`](../interpretation/active_return.md)

```math
\mathrm{AR} = P \, \bar a = \frac{P}{m} \sum_{t=1}^{m} (r_t - b_t)
```

### Information ratio — [`information_ratio`](../interpretation/information_ratio.md)

```math
\mathrm{IR} = \frac{P \, \bar a}{s_a \sqrt{P}} = \frac{\bar a}{s_a} \sqrt{P}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Tracking error is exactly zero (fund equals benchmark plus a constant).

### Treynor ratio — [`treynor_ratio`](../interpretation/treynor_ratio.md)

```math
\mathrm{TR} = \frac{P\,(\bar r^{(m)} - r_f)}{\hat\beta}, \quad r_f = 0, \quad \bar r^{(m)} = \frac{1}{m} \sum_{t=1}^{m} r_t \text{ (aligned periods)}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Benchmark returns are constant (beta undefined). Estimated beta is exactly zero.

### Upside capture ratio — [`upside_capture`](../interpretation/upside_capture.md)

```math
\mathrm{UC} = \frac{G(U, r)}{G(U, b)}, \quad U = \{t : b_t > 0\}, \quad G(S, x) = \begin{cases} \left(\prod_{t \in S} (1 + x_t)\right)^{P/|S|} - 1 & \prod_{t \in S} (1 + x_t) > 0 \\ -1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: The benchmark has no up periods in the overlap. The benchmark's compounded up-period return is exactly zero.

### Downside capture ratio — [`downside_capture`](../interpretation/downside_capture.md)

```math
\mathrm{DC} = \frac{G(D, r)}{G(D, b)}, \quad D = \{t : b_t < 0\} \quad (G \text{ as for upside capture})
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: The benchmark has no down periods in the overlap. The benchmark's compounded down-period return is exactly zero.

### Capture ratio (upside / downside capture) — [`capture_ratio`](../interpretation/capture_ratio.md)

```math
\mathrm{CR} = \frac{\mathrm{UC}}{\mathrm{DC}}, \quad \mathrm{DC} > 0
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Upside or downside capture is undefined (no up or no down benchmark periods, or a zero compounded benchmark return on one side). Downside capture is zero or negative (the fund gained on average when the benchmark fell); the ratio's sign would then be meaningless. Upside and downside capture are still reported.

### Batting average (share of periods beating the benchmark) — [`batting_average`](../interpretation/batting_average.md)

```math
\mathrm{BA} = \frac{1}{m} \sum_{t=1}^{m} \mathbf{1}[\,r_t > b_t\,]; \quad \mathrm{BA}^{\uparrow} = \frac{\#\{t : r_t > b_t,\ b_t > 0\}}{\#\{t : b_t > 0\}}, \ \mathrm{BA}^{\downarrow} = \frac{\#\{t : r_t > b_t,\ b_t < 0\}}{\#\{t : b_t < 0\}}
```

### Residual (specific) volatility (annualized) — [`residual_volatility`](../interpretation/residual_volatility.md)

```math
\hat\sigma_\varepsilon \sqrt{P}, \quad \hat\sigma_\varepsilon = \sqrt{\frac{1}{m-2} \sum_{t=1}^{m} \hat\varepsilon_t^2}, \quad \hat\varepsilon_t = r_t - \hat\alpha - \hat\beta b_t
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Benchmark returns are constant over the aligned periods.

### Appraisal ratio — [`appraisal_ratio`](../interpretation/appraisal_ratio.md)

```math
\mathrm{AppR} = \frac{P \, \hat\alpha}{\hat\sigma_\varepsilon \sqrt{P}} = \frac{\hat\alpha}{\hat\sigma_\varepsilon} \sqrt{P}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Benchmark returns are constant over the aligned periods. Residual volatility is zero to floating-point precision (below sqrt(machine epsilon) x fund volatility, i.e. 1 - R-squared below machine epsilon): the benchmark explains the fund exactly.

### M-squared (Modigliani risk-adjusted return) — [`m_squared`](../interpretation/m_squared.md)

```math
M^2 = P \, \frac{\bar r^{(m)} - r_f}{s_r^{(m)}} \, s_b + P\, r_f, \quad r_f = 0; \quad M^2 - P \bar b \ \text{(details)}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Fund returns are constant over the aligned periods (zero volatility). Benchmark returns are constant over the aligned periods (zero volatility).

### Bull-market beta — [`bull_beta`](../interpretation/bull_beta.md)

```math
\hat\beta^{+} = \text{OLS slope of } r_t = \alpha^{+} + \beta^{+} b_t + \varepsilon_t \text{ over } \{t : b_t > 0\}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Fewer than 3 benchmark up periods in the overlap. Benchmark returns are constant over the up periods.

### Bear-market beta — [`bear_beta`](../interpretation/bear_beta.md)

```math
\hat\beta^{-} = \text{OLS slope of } r_t = \alpha^{-} + \beta^{-} b_t + \varepsilon_t \text{ over } \{t : b_t < 0\}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Fewer than 3 benchmark down periods in the overlap. Benchmark returns are constant over the down periods.

### Timing ratio (bull beta / bear beta) — [`timing_ratio`](../interpretation/timing_ratio.md)

```math
\mathrm{TR}_{\text{timing}} = \frac{\hat\beta^{+}}{\hat\beta^{-}}, \quad \hat\beta^{-} > 0
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Bull-market or bear-market beta is undefined (fewer than 3 up or down periods, or a constant benchmark within a regime). Bear-market beta is zero or negative; the ratio's sign would be meaningless. Both betas are still reported.

## Factor analysis

### Factor-model alpha (annualized) — [`factor_alpha`](../interpretation/factor_alpha.md)

```math
\alpha_{\text{ann}} = P \, \hat\alpha, \quad y_t = \alpha + \sum_{j=1}^{k} \beta_j f_{j,t} + \varepsilon_t, \quad y_t = r_t - r^{\mathrm{RF}}_t, \quad t = 1..m
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: A factor is constant over the aligned periods. The factor returns are perfectly collinear over the aligned periods.

### Factor-model alpha t-statistic (Newey-West) — [`factor_alpha_t_statistic`](../interpretation/factor_alpha_t_statistic.md)

```math
t_\alpha = \frac{\hat\alpha}{\widehat{\mathrm{SE}}_{\mathrm{HAC}}(\hat\alpha)}, \quad \widehat{V}_{\mathrm{HAC}} = \frac{m}{m-k-1} (X^\top X)^{-1} \hat S (X^\top X)^{-1}, \quad \hat S = \sum_{\ell=-q}^{q} \Big(1 - \frac{|\ell|}{q+1}\Big) \hat\Gamma_\ell, \quad q = \big\lfloor 4 (m/100)^{2/9} \big\rfloor
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: A factor is constant or the factors are perfectly collinear. The factors reproduce the fund exactly (residuals zero or below floating-point resolution), so the standard error is zero.

### Factor-model R-squared — [`factor_r_squared`](../interpretation/factor_r_squared.md)

```math
R^2 = 1 - \frac{\sum_{t=1}^{m} \hat\varepsilon_t^2}{\sum_{t=1}^{m} (y_t - \bar y)^2}, \quad \bar R^2 = 1 - (1 - R^2) \frac{m - 1}{m - k - 1}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: A factor is constant or the factors are perfectly collinear. The dependent variable is constant (no variance to explain).

### Factor-model residual volatility (annualized) — [`factor_residual_volatility`](../interpretation/factor_residual_volatility.md)

```math
\sigma_\varepsilon = \sqrt{\frac{\sum_{t=1}^{m} \hat\varepsilon_t^2}{m-k-1}} \, \sqrt{P}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: A factor is constant or the factors are perfectly collinear.

## Statistical confidence

### Probabilistic Sharpe Ratio (vs 0) — [`probabilistic_sharpe_ratio`](../interpretation/probabilistic_sharpe_ratio.md)

```math
\mathrm{PSR} = \Phi\!\left( \frac{(\widehat{SR} - SR^*)\sqrt{n-1}}{\sqrt{1 - g_3 \widehat{SR} + \frac{g_4 - 1}{4} \widehat{SR}^2}} \right), \quad \widehat{SR} = \frac{\bar r}{s}, \ g_3 = \frac{m_3}{m_2^{3/2}}, \ g_4 = \frac{m_4}{m_2^2}, \ SR^* = 0
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Sample standard deviation is exactly zero. Return variance underflows in floating point (moments not computable). The variance factor is not positive (degenerate distribution).

### Sharpe ratio standard error (annualized) — [`sharpe_ratio_standard_error`](../interpretation/sharpe_ratio_standard_error.md)

```math
\mathrm{SE}(\widehat{SR}_{\text{ann}}) = \sqrt{P} \sqrt{\frac{1 - g_3 \widehat{SR} + \frac{g_4 - 1}{4} \widehat{SR}^2}{n - 1}}, \quad \mathrm{CI}_{95} = \widehat{SR}\sqrt{P} \pm z_{0.975} \, \mathrm{SE}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Sample standard deviation is exactly zero. Return variance underflows in floating point (moments not computable). The variance factor is not positive (degenerate distribution).

### Minimum track record length — [`minimum_track_record_length`](../interpretation/minimum_track_record_length.md)

```math
\mathrm{MinTRL} = 1 + \left(1 - g_3 \widehat{SR} + \frac{g_4 - 1}{4} \widehat{SR}^2\right) \left( \frac{z_{0.95}}{\widehat{SR} - SR^*} \right)^2, \quad SR^* = 0
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: The observed Sharpe ratio is not above the reference 0 (no track-record length can make it significant). Sample standard deviation is exactly zero. Return variance underflows in floating point (moments not computable).

### Mean return standard error (per period) — [`mean_return_standard_error`](../interpretation/mean_return_standard_error.md)

```math
\mathrm{SE}(\bar r) = \frac{s}{\sqrt{n}}, \quad \mathrm{CI}_{95} = \bar r \pm t_{0.975,\,n-1} \, \frac{s}{\sqrt{n}}, \quad t = \frac{\bar r}{\mathrm{SE}(\bar r)}
```

Undefined (`not_applicable`) when: Sample standard deviation is exactly zero (no sampling variability).
